name: Berkshire-Rome Vendors' Market
description: Berkshire-Rome Vendors' Market is a farmers market in 101 W. Dominick St., NY, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
